jess.docs: Heads-up: updating Optimize Toolkit SDK examples. Found two small incompatibilities in published snippets (Go/JS). Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/521 — can eng/infra sanity-check?
ryan.eng: on it. what's failing?
jess.docs: Go snippet used numeric BatchWindow (20) rather than string with units ("20ms"). JS example used snake_case kv_prefetch. Both cause 400s in QA.
arya.infra: confirmed from staging logs: {\"error\":\"invalid_config_field\",\"field\":\"batch_window\",\"message\":\"expected string with units, got number\"} — include that exact JSON in troubleshooting.
tom.ml: also suggest adding a one-line guidance on KV prefetch: "KV prefetch improves short-turn cache hits but may increase memory — toggle per route."
jess.docs: updated snippets below, please check: 
```go
import "github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/go/redwood"
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
cfg := redwood.Config{
  Batching: true,
  BatchWindow: "20ms", // string required
  KVPrefetch: true,
  QuantProfile: "q4_0_fast_v2",
}
```
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const cfg = { batching: true, batchWindow: '20ms', kvPrefetch: true, quantProfile: 'q4_0_fast_v2' }
```
ryan.eng: LGTM. note: link anchors on the Batching page changed to #sdk-params-go and #sdk-params-javascript — fixed in PR.
preview-bot: :white_check_mark: preview build succeeded for PR 521 — https://deploy-preview-521--docs.redwood.ai/optimize/batching (expires in 48h)
jess.docs: thanks all — will merge once Ryan gives final thumbs. 
ryan.eng: approving now. :thumbsup:
